CanonicalKeywords.rationale: `{ CardKeyword.Exhaust }` (SecretTechnique.cs:13) == `self.exhausts = True`, set in `_init_vars` so `downgrade()` can undo the upgrade's `RemoveKeyword` -- the correct pattern, and `card_probes.py downgrade` does not list secret_technique.

ctor.rationale: `base(0, CardType.Skill, CardRarity.Rare, TargetType.Self)` (SecretTechnique.cs:15-18) == cost 0 / SKILL / RARE / SELF. No CanonicalVars -- exactly one card is taken.

OnPlay.rationale: `CardSelectCmd.FromCombatPile(prefs: (prompt, 1), pile: PileType.Draw.GetPile(Owner), filter: c => c.Type == CardType.Skill)` then `CardPileCmd.Add(cardModel, PileType.Hand)` if non-null (SecretTechnique.cs:22-26) == `CardSelectCmd.from_pile(ctx.hooks, player.draw_pile, 'from_draw', count=1, predicate=lambda c: c.card_type == self._WANTED_TYPE)` then the manual draw-pile-to-hand move. The sim's explicit `MAX_HAND_SIZE` break (colorless_skills.py:619-620) is not an addition: C#'s `CardPileCmd.Add` enforces `CardPile.MaxCardsInHand` inside AddInternal, so both refuse to overfill a 10-card hand. Secret Technique cannot select itself -- it is not in the draw pile on either side. BLAST RADIUS, not re-verdicted here per rule 3: `CardSelectCmd` auto-selects with no player choice and no RNG at or below MinSelect (CardSelectCmd.cs:287-290) where the sim's `select_cards` always delegates to the installed selector and otherwise falls back to `self._rng.sample` (combat.py:575-581) -- creature_card_cmds steps 104/105 and guard N10.

OnUpgrade.rationale: `RemoveKeyword(CardKeyword.Exhaust)` (SecretTechnique.cs:31) == `self.exhausts = False`. No printed number changes on either side.
